pages.title: a(n) is the period of {F(F(k)) mod n}
pages.note: F(F(k)) only. Gives the upper bound a(n) divides A001175(A001175(n)). No L(L), L(F) or 5^k formula.

pages.title: T. Lengyel, The Order of the Fibonacci and Lucas Numbers, Fibonacci Quarterly 33.3 (1995)
pages.note: Source of Lemma V (its Lemma 1). p-adic orders of F(n) and L(n), and an application to Stirling numbers. No composed sequences.

pages.title: S. Yokura, A remark on periods of periodic sequences modulo m
pages.note: Partial sums of generalized Fibonacci sequences. No composed sequences.

pages.title: B. Benfield, O. Lippard, Fixed points of K-Fibonacci sequences
pages.read: about 90 percent verbatim, plus a keyword search of the whole PDF
pages.note: Iterates the period function pi(pi(m)), a different object from the composed sequence.

pages.title: J.C. Saunders, R.N. Stephens, Residues of Terms of Lucas Sequences Modulo 3^k
pages.read: about 84 percent verbatim; the end including Future Work was not read
pages.note: General Lucas sequences mod 3^k. No composed sequences in the part read.

pages.title: Chuysurichay, Jaidee, Panraksa, Ward, The local Dold congruence for Fibonacci and Lucas sequences
pages.read: abstract, plus a keyword search of the whole PDF
pages.note: Dold congruences. No composed sequences found.
